# Responses of a protected route

Measured with the real Express SDK (`@licenroute/connect-express`) in LicenRoute's tests.

| HTTP | Body (`error`) | When | What to say / do |
|---|---|---|---|
| 200 | (the app) | public route, or valid licence with quota | — |
| 402 | `payment_required` (+ `payment.plan_id`, `checkout_url`) | no licence, licence for another plan, quota exhausted, expired licence | Correct on a paid route. There is no automatic charge. |
| 403 | `forbidden` | made-up or revoked licence; or the plan is **not activated** (BL-11) | If it is "not activated": `./node_modules/.bin/licenroute test` activates them in the simulator once the app has started (its SDK attests). |
| 429 | `rate_limited` + `Retry-After` | above the licence's per-minute limit | Wait for `Retry-After`. |
| 503 | `licensed_route_not_covered` + `Retry-After: 30` | the SDK does not yet have a verified policy covering the route and method: right at startup (`/health/ready` = 503) or plan not published / `licensedPaths` different from the plan (also in its methods) | Wait for `/health/ready`; check that the plan exists on the site with the same methods (`doctor`, `licenroute test`). |
| 503 | `service_unavailable` + `Retry-After: 5` | LicenRoute did not answer in time (down, or slower than `timeoutMs`: 200 ms without a licence, 1000 ms with one) | **Closed fallback on purpose**. See `doctor` (latency). Do not raise the timeout without measuring in the real environment. |

Non-paid routes with LicenRoute down: they stay open (`fallback: "allow"`). Health (`/health`, `/up`): they never go through
LicenRoute.
